messages:
alex: deploy finished to prod-eu @ 13:20 UTC. Rollout: v2-runtime (adaptive-batching) -> traffic stepped to 50% at ~13:24. Observing increased pod evictions and 5xx rate. Posting logs/metrics: https://rwd/obs/prod-eu/rollout/1732103456
maya (on-call): I'm on it. Paging SREs and ops. Can you paste the deploy command/flags?
alex: deploy command: `./deploy --service inference-runtime --image rwd/runtime:v2-batch --strategy gradual --step 10% --batching=adaptive` . We toggled `batch_mem_limit=0.75` as an experiment.
deploy-bot: [DEPLOY] rollout 1732103456 completed by alex. strategy=gradual steps=[10,25,50].
simon: joining the thread. seeing repeated `OOMKilled` events on inference-pool-eu nodes and kube eviction traces. Pod memory spikes before crash. kube events: `ContainerOOM`.
jia: metrics show KV-cache warmup + large prefetch from model variants. `cache_miss_rate` spiked x6, `mem_rss` on pods jumped just before evictions. Also queue_depth for sender-proxy climbed.
maya (on-call): customer impact? which tenants? any high-volume customers affected?
alex: several customers in EU reported elevated latency and timeouts. 95p latency up 3-5x and 5xx rate ~4.2% across routes served by v2. Non-EU regions unaffected.
incident-bot: INCIDENT OPENED: INF-2026-173210 (severity: P2). Oncall escalation triggered (pager -> simon).
ops-rotations-bot: @maya, shift handover note: be aware of active deploys this shift.
simon: quick plan: 1) stop further rollout step, 2) reduce traffic to v2 -> rollback to v1 or shift traffic back to a stable variant, 3) throttle prefetch/pipeline that warms cache.
maya (on-call): agreed. Alex, can you pause the rollout and scale down v2 replicas to 0 while we evaluate? If pause not possible, revert traffic to previous model.
alex: pause attempted: `deployctl pause 1732103456` -> paused at 50%. Trying `deployctl revert --to v1-runtime` now.
alex: Revert submitted. `deployctl rollback --release v1-runtime --target prod-eu` (cmd output attached). Rolling back streaming in.
jia: while rollback proceeds, I'm disabling aggressive warmup: toggling config `prefetch.enabled=false` and lowering `batch_mem_limit=0.5` on remaining v2 pods.
simon: also increasing eviction thresholds on nodepool as temporary mitigation: `kubectl patch nodepool inference-eu -p '{"spec":{"evictionThreshold":"20%"}}'` (watching safety risk).
maya (on-call): prioritize customer-facing mitigation (traffic shift) over cluster knobs. Simon, coordinate with infra if nodepatch causes risk.
alice (ops, via DM): FYI infra approves temporary threshold bump for 20m.
alex: traffic shifted back to v1 at 13:30 UTC. Monitoring shows 5xx dropping.
ops-rotations-bot: action log: pause rollout, rollback started, prefetchoff, memlimit lowered, nodepool threshold bumped.
jia: metrics at 13:35: `5xx_rate` down to 0.4%, 95p latency back near baseline, pod evictions stopped. KV-cache miss tapering.
simon: rolling windows look stable. Recommend to keep v1 and block v2 until we root cause batching memory pattern.
maya (on-call): tagging as mitigated for now. Creating incident ticket INF-2026-173210 and scheduling full oncall postmortem tomorrow 09:30 UTC. Assigning owners: root cause (eng-runtime), infra followup (eng-infra), rollout safety (devex).
alex: notes for postmortem: v2 adaptive batching prefetch + larger mem limit -> cache warmup causing transient mem pressure -> node OOM evictions during burst. We stepped traffic too fast.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATED: status=mitigated. Assigned: eng-runtime (alex), eng-infra (simon), devex (jia). Postmortem meeting scheduled.
maya (on-call): thanks all. If anything regresses, re-open and page. Leaving handoff to simon for secondary monitoring until end of shift.
simon: standing by for 30m. I'll escalate to infra if any re-emergence.
alex: one action item I already put in PR: add pre-deploy enforced mem profile check + automatic traffic ramp caps for new runtime variants.
maya (on-call): good. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
